objective: Close the SD-007 mainline integration gap by making the existing product-owned hosted review gate run for pull requests targeting main and proving the exact required check on one cumulative main pull request.
scope: Add main to the existing pull_request base-branch filter without changing the required-check name, ordered product commands, permissions, runner, pins, or test semantics.
Preserve work/sd-006-release-communication as the exact protected stacked base for SignalDesk PR #5.
Finalize the product-owned SD-007 evidence with the corrected green revision and the independently evaluated non-mutating learning packet.
Open one cumulative pull request from work/sd-007a-mainline-gate to main and prove that the active ruleset requires the exact hosted check.
Leave the cumulative main pull request open and unmerged after proof.
non_goals: Merging or closing SignalDesk PR #4, PR #5, the cumulative SD-007A pull request, or Elder PR #6.
Changing any product feature, test command, required-check name, ruleset bypass, or protected-delivery policy.
SD-008, staging, production, deployment, release, rollback, P5.2 activation, canonical L2, L3, or canary work.
Applying the approved SD-007 learning candidate or mutating trusted memory, skills, policy, evaluators, architecture, or maturity.
evidence_plan: Foundation: validate the separate work item and both exact workflow base branches while preserving least privilege, immutable action pins, the exact check name, and the exact ordered commands.
Component, Integration, Workflow, Stress, Build, Audit, and Elder: rerun the unchanged product-owned ladder one level at a time.
Hosted: bind the cumulative main pull request, exact base and head objects, workflow run, job, check, active ruleset, no-bypass state, and final open unmerged state.
Traceability: finalize SD-007 product evidence and issue a bounded SD-007A handoff without starting deployment or SD-008.
failure_conditions: A pull request targeting main does not create signaldesk-ordered-review-gate.
The hosted command order, check name, permissions, runner, action pins, ruleset targets, or bypass state drifts.
The cumulative pull request is not bound to the declared main base and exact correction head.
Any SignalDesk or Elder pull request is merged, or staging, production, deployment, release, rollback, SD-008, P5.2, or L3 begins.
